```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df_raw <- read_csv("../data/main_sheet.csv")
```

Function to convert unusually formatted dates into standard format

```{r}
days_per_year <- 28  # A year is 28 days not 365

convert_length <- function(x) {
  m <- str_match(x, "(\\d+)\\+?\\s*(day|year)")
  num  <- as.numeric(m[, 2]) # pull out the number
  unit <- m[, 3] # pull out the unit (day or year)
  
  years <- case_when(
    unit == "day" ~ floor(num / days_per_year),
    unit == "year" ~ num
  )
  
  case_when(
    is.na(unit) ~ x, # don't change entries that are already just a number or <1
    unit == "day" & years < 1 ~ "<1",
    TRUE ~ as.character(years)
  )
}
```

```{r}
df <- df_raw %>%
  rename(
    birth_island = `Birth island`,
    relationship_length = `Relationship Length`
  ) %>%
  mutate(relationship_length = convert_length(relationship_length)) %>% # convert to standard format
  mutate(
    relationship_length = case_when(
      relationship_length == "none" ~ NA_real_,
      relationship_length == "<1" ~ 0.5, # so it shows up on a numerical axis
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(relationship_length)
    ),
    Married = Married == "yes" | Married == "Yes",
    Island = case_when(
      Island == "Bonne Santé" ~ "Bonne Sante",
      TRUE ~ Island
    )
    )

df_people <- df %>%
  group_by(Name, Age, House, City, Island) %>%
  summarise(
    n_relationships = sum(!is.na(relationship_length)),
    ever_married = any(Married),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
df$relationship_length
```

Age distribution on each island

```{r}
df %>%
  ggplot(aes(Age, fill = Island)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~Island, ncol = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Number of relationships islanders have been in

```{r}
df_people %>%
  ggplot(aes(n_relationships, fill = Island)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(1))
```

Relationship length histogram by island

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(relationship_length)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(relationship_length, fill = Island)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~Island, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
df_short_rel <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(relationship_length)) %>%
  mutate(short_rel = relationship_length < 1) %>%
  group_by(Island) %>%
  summarise(prop_short = mean(short_rel), n = n())

df_short_rel %>%
  ggplot(aes(Island, prop_short, fill = Island)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of relationships lasting less than 1 year",
       x = NULL, y = "Percent") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(relationship_length)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Age, relationship_length, color = Married)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Island) +
  labs(title = "Relationship length vs. age")
```
